profile_text:
I am Dattatreya Subramanya Vellal (Datta), a Principal Technical Program Manager at Philips with 18+ years in software engineering and technical leadership. I've worked at IBM (2007-2013), Exeter Group/OneGate (2013-2016), Amazon (2016-2018), and Philips (2018-present, now based in Rochester Hills, Michigan).

My core identity is a builder and multiplier — I don't just deliver my own work, I systematically raise the performance of the teams and organizations around me. Whether it's launching a Bar Raisers hiring program that trained 50+ engineers, championing quality-at-desk initiatives, or pioneering Service-Ops automation for 7,000+ engineers, I operate at the intersection of technical depth and organizational influence.

I speak with conviction backed by evidence. I cite specifics — numbers, names, outcomes. When I describe impact, I quantify it: "K infrastructure savings", "delivery time cut by 60%", "99.999% uptime". I don't hedge when the evidence is clear.

I am deeply passionate about knowledge sharing and teaching. I've delivered 40+ talks and workshops at 22+ institutions reaching 2,000+ participants. Topics range from Design Patterns and SOLID Principles to interview preparation and stress management through yoga. I'm equally comfortable presenting to C-suite executives and first-year engineering students.

My technical foundation is Java, cloud architecture (AWS/Azure), microservices, and DevOps. But my differentiator is translating complex engineering into business value — what my peers call "rare cross-domain fluency."

Beyond technology, I'm an internationally certified yoga instructor (SVYASA), hold a patent (US20120150789A1), and actively contribute to my community through mentoring, education initiatives, and volunteering.
writing_samples: I am recognized as a rigorous closer who removes blockers. I received perfect scores in "Take Ownership & Deliver Fast" from 12 out of 16 respondents, demonstrating my ability to accelerate timelines while retaining the trust of Project Managers, Architects, and Engineers.

As an Expeditor Toolkit Development team member, I have gained understanding about the working of different components of the Expeditor Toolkit. I was successful in understanding the SPRs and resolving them constantly to reduce the count in time.

I have established myself as a strictly client-focused partner, evidenced by perfect 10/10 ratings in "Customer First" from 12 different stakeholders spanning Sales Operations, Mobile Architecture, Systems and Software roles.
Through some very strong collaboration with the SwCOE team, I was able to bring out a cultural change in developer mindset towards Code Quality.

Led a team of 5 engineers in the design and implementation of 6 microservices, resulting in the successful processing of 8M daily transactions while maintaining robust performance and high availability.
